failure_modes.description: The agent receives contradictory findings from multiple specialized visual analysis tools (e.g., one affirmative, one negative) and incorrectly prioritizes the negative or less specialized output, leading to a false negative conclusion despite the presence of correct affirmative evidence in the context.
failure_modes.needed_instead: A reconciliation strategy that weights specialized expert tool outputs higher than generalist VQA outputs when they conflict, or a mandatory verification step using raw image inspection when tools disagree.

representative_evidence.quote: The agent synthesized these conflicting signals but ultimately relied on the negative finding from llava_med_qa to conclude 'B. no', ignoring the affirmative evidence from CheXagent

success_habits.description: The agent avoids reliance on a single model by querying multiple independent sources (specialized experts, grounded reports, ROI crops) and cross-validating findings before finalizing an answer.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Increased susceptibility to false positives/negatives from individual model errors and reduced robustness against image quality artifacts.

success_habits.description: When faced with conflicting tool outputs, the agent invokes a dedicated verification tool to inspect specific anatomical features in the original image rather than guessing based on text outputs alone.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: The agent may accept incorrect tool outputs or remain uncertain, leading to lower accuracy in ambiguous cases.

success_habits.description: For straightforward modality or feature identification tasks, the agent performs direct visual analysis without unnecessary tool dependency, providing explicit feature-based justification.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: Unnecessary latency and token consumption for simple queries, with no accuracy gain.
